semiconductor_relevance: High — AUROS Technology specializes in metrology and inspection equipment specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AUROS Technology, Inc. develops and supplies advanced overlay metrology tools and inspection systems for semiconductor fabrication. Founded in 2009, the company has established a strong presence in the Korean and Chinese markets, providing proven solutions to major clients in the global semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Korea: AUROS Technology is based in Korea and has successfully supplied its technology to numerous local fabs.
regional_presence.China: The company has also established a presence in China, providing its metrology tools to major clients.
